lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twelve pi? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 12π? Nope!

lines.text: A circle in a square of side eight. A smaller square has its corners on that circle.
lines.caption: A circle in a square of side 8. A smaller square has its corners on that circle.

lines.text: A smaller circle fits inside. What's the area of the shaded ring?
lines.caption: A smaller circle fits inside. What's the area of the shaded ring?

lines.text: The small square has its corners mid-side. Fold the four corner triangles in!
lines.caption: The small square has its corners mid-side. Fold the 4 corner triangles in!

lines.text: They cover the small square exactly! Each is eight, so four make thirty-two.
lines.caption: They cover the small square exactly! Each is 8, so 4 make 32.

lines.text: That's half of sixty-four. Same shape, so the small circle is half too!
lines.caption: That's half of 64. Same shape, so the small circle is half too!

lines.text: The big circle is sixteen pi. The ring is the other half: eight pi!
lines.caption: The big circle is 16π. The ring is the other half: 8π!

lines.text: Did you get eight pi? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 8π? Tell me below!
